headline: Least-levered major with a credible self-help story, but the 2026 rally already prices in much of the turnaround.
business: Largest domestic carrier by passengers, with an all-737 fleet and a point-to-point network. It is mid-transformation, adding bag fees, assigned and premium seating, and partnerships to raise revenue per seat.
recent: Q3 2026 record operating revenue of $8.42B (+21.2%); adjusted EPS $0.66; GAAP net income $270M vs $54M a year earlier.
Full-year 2026 adjusted EPS guidance now $2.60-$2.85, down from $3.25-$4.25 in July, on higher fuel; Q4 guided to $0.55-$0.80.
Stock up 47% over 12 months, the best of any major, as investors reward the business-model changes.
strengths: Lowest leverage in the group (net debt/EBITDA 1.2x)
Self-help revenue initiatives independent of the cycle
risks: Thin 4.4% operating margin; cost inflation from labor deals
Only 13% upside to consensus target after the rally
Domestic-only exposure to a consumer slowdown
catalysts: Revenue uplift from seating and fee initiatives
